propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide contract, allowing padded plans to pass without required sections like Approach, grounded Scope, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity measure is duplicated in gates.py and det_floor.py with inconsistent logic, creating maintenance drift and enabling missing bug branch in det_floor.py.
Author guidance for Success Criteria conflicts with test requirements and active epic 1386; current guidance should not encode Success Criteria as deterministic check.

Required-section checks should be keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) rather than ticket type, with Context/Problem and AC mandatory for all plans, and Approach/Scope mandatory only for leaf nodes.
Seven candidate deterministic additions lack mechanically-testable detection rules and evidence of precision, requiring prioritization and false-positive validation before corpus integration.
